evidence.source_statement: For applications producing logs, traces or crash reports, verify useful failure context is captured without inadvertently recording credentials or private user data; document opt-in collection where applicable.
source_conditions: An authorized Rust project is being created from scratch and the specified concern is part of its accepted purpose or supported user contract.
